provenance.seam: Real WordPress 7.0: BlockDocument creation, native Gutenberg serialization comparison, shared Font weight inspector edit, save, reload with zero invalid blocks, authenticated public REST fields, real draft preview rendering.
provenance.normalization: None: IDs, local URLs, HTML and neutral trees are captured response values. Preview captures public header/main only, omitting authenticated administration chrome.
provenance.contextBoundary: Post Content is a contextual node with null content. Supply the captured post context and its separately delivered neutralNodes; do not synthesize content from layout placeholders. Template creation is fixture setup; the page document is the document saved and reopened in Gutenberg. The preview-only template lacks the three Design region references: layout delivery rejects it with the captured 422 response, so this fixture makes no layout endpoint acceptance claim.
